name: data flow task - gptm trans daily hist

typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EFF_DT as timestamp,
		CLIENTLINKEDDEALSREFERENCE as string,
		PE_REF as string,
		CONSIDERATION as decimal(38,15),
		INV as string,
		PIS_ORIGINALAMTVAL as decimal(38,15),
		CNTRPTY as string,
		SALESPERSON as string,
		DFVERSION as decimal(38,15),
		TXN_STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSourcep011isp	source(output(
		EffDate as date
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSourcep011isp derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> GetCurrentdate
GetCurrentdate derive({Copy of PIS_ORIGINALAMTVAL} = PIS_ORIGINALAMTVAL,
		{Copy of CONSIDERATION} = CONSIDERATION,
		{Copy of CLIENTLINKEDDEALSREFERENCE} = CLIENTLINKEDDEALSREFERENCE,
		{Copy of DFVERSION} = DFVERSION,
		{Copy of EFF_DT} = toDate(EFF_DT, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of INV} = INV,
		{Copy of PE_REF} = PE_REF,
		{Copy of SALESPERSON} = SALESPERSON,
		{Copy of TXN_STATUS} = TXN_STATUS,
		{Copy of CNTRPTY} = CNTRPTY,
		{Copy of loadDate} = loadDate) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,LookupLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of EFF_DT} == EffDate,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		INV as string,
		PIS_ORIGINALAMTVAL as integer,
		PE_REF as string,
		DFVERSION as integer,
		SALESPERSON as string,
		EFFDATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CONSIDERATION as integer,
		TXN_Status as string,
		CLIENTLINKEDDEALSREFERENCE as string,
		CNTRPTY as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		INV = {Copy of INV},
		PIS_ORIGINALAMTVAL = {Copy of PIS_ORIGINALAMTVAL},
		PE_REF = {Copy of PE_REF},
		DFVERSION = {Copy of DFVERSION},
		SALESPERSON = {Copy of SALESPERSON},
		EFFDATE = {Copy of EFF_DT},
		CONSIDERATION = {Copy of CONSIDERATION},
		TXN_Status = {Copy of TXN_STATUS},
		CLIENTLINKEDDEALSREFERENCE = {Copy of CLIENTLINKEDDEALSREFERENCE},
		CNTRPTY = {Copy of CNTRPTY},
		loadDate = {Copy of loadDate}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
